lines: Seat 1 chooses Spellweaver: at the end, 1 point per different spell cast beyond the first, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 2) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Hexer: at the end, 1 point per Scorch or Blight cast, up to 3.
Bid 2 mana on the Shifting tile at (0, 1) (yields 1).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 7 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Steady tile at (-2, 2) (yields 2) at 3 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 2 wins the Shifting tile at (0, 1) (yields 1) for 2 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Steady tile at (-2, 2) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (2, 0) (yields 1) for free.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2).

If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2) for 3 mana.

Pass: you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Wild tile at (1, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 7 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 3 wins the Shifting tile at (0, -1) (yields 3) for 3 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Wild tile at (1, 0) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 2 gets the Wild tile at (-1, 0) (yields 2) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Seat 1's trait is Spellweaver.
Seat 2's trait is Hexer.
Seat 3's trait is Wanderer.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 5 mana.
Seat 2 collects 5 mana.
Seat 3 collects 6 mana.
Summon 6 Imps at (-1, 0) for 6 mana, leaving 3.
Cast Blight for 4 mana: the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2) yields nothing in the next round's income.
Summon 3 Imps at (1, 0) for 3 mana, leaving 9.
All together: 7 mana, leaving 5.
Round 1.
Seat 3 attunes the Shifting tile at (0, -2) (yields 3) for 4 mana.
Seat 1 summons 3 Imps at (1, 0).
Seat 2 summons 6 Imps at (-1, 0).
Seat 1 casts Blight on the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2): it yields nothing next round.
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Round 2 of 8 begins.
An Unveil reveals the Steady tile at (0, 2) (yields 2, guarded by power 3); the Shifting tile at (1, -2) (yields 2); the Shifting tile at (0, 0) (yields 2); the Steady tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2).
Seat 1 collects 5 mana.
Seat 2 collects 3 mana.
Seat 3 collects 9 mana.
Move 3 Imps from (1, 0) to (1, 1).
Cast Lure for 3 mana: the guards at (0, 2) drop to power 2, for good.

Attack the Steady tile at (0, 2) (yields 2, guarded by power 3) (guarded by monsters, power 2 after your Lure) with 3 Imps (power 3). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 1 Imp. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 3 mana, leaving 7.
Cast Ward for 3 mana: (0, 1) defends with 3 more power this round.

Attack the Shifting tile at (0, -1) (yields 3) (Seat 3's, held by no units, power 0) with 6 Imps (power 6). As things stand, you win and take it, keeping 6 Imps. Units that attack don't defend their own tiles this round.
All together: 3 mana, leaving 3.
Round 2.
Seat 1 moves 1 group of units.
Seat 3 summons 4 Golems at (-2, 0).
Seat 1 casts Lure on (0, 2): its guards drop to power 2.
Seat 2 casts Ward on (0, 1): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 3 casts Ward on (-2, 0): it defends with 3 more power this round.
Seat 2 (6 Imps) attack the Shifting tile at (0, -1) (yields 3), Seat 3's, held by no units: power 6 against 0.
Seat 2 takes (0, -1) with 6 Imps.
Seat 1 (3 Imps) attack the Steady tile at (0, 2) (yields 2, guarded by power 2), guarded by monsters: power 3 against 2.
